body.x: Omron introduced a smartwatch with blood pressure monitoring at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Omron has developed the smartwatch which is a wrist pressure monitor and activity tracker. It not only monitors blood pressure monitoring from within the miniaturized SmartWatch, it also enables the use of general Smart Watch functions. Using the Omron Connect application provides a graphical representation of the health of blood pressure and maintains as much data as needed. They can also consult doctors and other health professionals within the application.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
